summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.31/5230)

data.turoyo: Azze, komər bu Mgalyun: "Maqəmle hən, aṯən li walaye d Urəšlem w mwabaxxe ah həḏoye ste..."
data.translation: He went, it says in the Gospel: "He raised some; they came to the city of Jerusalem and rebuked the Jews too..."

rationale: Adds the missing Preterit box to a stem previously illustrated only by Infectum. The coordinated aṯən ... w mwabaxxe makes the plural rebuking event intelligible; inherited sense 1 covers it.

summary: Jan 2.31/5230 supports inherited II.1 Vorhaltungen machen, with plural actors in the preceding aṯən clause and zero-marked personal object ah həḏoye. No separate sense is required.
The attested Preterit mwabaxxe extends the form coverage beyond the sole inherited Infectum example; the inherited base forms mwabaxle/mwabəx are retained.

The inherited Infectum example has no numeric sense tag in the input. For the per-sense count it is counted under the sole inherited sense 1; this implicit association needs no substantive correction.
The passage is quoted Gospel material within Jan prose. Its wording is retained as supplied; the accompanying English remains project machine translation, not an edition translation.
Can the editors confirm the segmentation of the plural Preterit ending in mwabaxxe against the inherited singular mwabaxle? No paradigm beyond the inherited forms is reconstructed.
